description: This file contains a function 'runAdditionalEvaluators' that executes various evaluators on output data, supporting numeric, JSON, and text evaluations, and includes helper functions for expression evaluation.

classes.name: EvaluatorReturnType
classes.description: Interface defining the structure of evaluator result objects, including name, type, operator, measure, value, and result status.

methods.name: runAdditionalEvaluators
methods.description: Asynchronously runs specified evaluators on provided output data, returning evaluation results and metrics counts.

methods.name: evaluateExpression
methods.description: Evaluates a numeric expression based on the operator and expected value, returning a boolean result.
